text: In the small town of Chanderi, men stay indoors after ten during a four-day festival, because [a woman's spirit takes them|threat|the restless dead] and [leaves only their clothes behind|images|clothes, jewellery and keepsakes]. Townsfolk paint [O Stree Kal Aana on their walls|rules|faith and charms protect] to keep her moving on. Vicky, a ladies' tailor, falls for a nameless woman who orders a lehenga and keeps disappearing. When his friend Jana is taken, a half-burnt book reveals that Stree was [a courtesan murdered by the town's men|origin|the wronged dead return] before she could marry.
